Checks: All scripts parse in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
Equal-length patch preserves UTF8 and offsets; repeated file/block hashes are scoped to core.js.
Verified recovery restores exact original bytes.
Stale recovery cannot overwrite a newer client version.
After an update, the new version gets its own verified original snapshot.
Unknown and ambiguous menu layouts are refused without overwriting.
Shared core storage, invalid hashes and truncated headers fail closed.
Legacy backups are imported only after reproducing the patched bytes.
A running client fixture prevents modification.
Real watcher repairs same-name updates and newly named hot-update packages automatically.
A stop request cancels a queued patch before writing; rollback cannot be repatched by the watcher.
Real logon task uses installed runtime, survives source-folder relocation, and disables cleanly.
Local paths and account/host identifiers are masked.
